PostGUI can automatically adapt any PostgreSQL database to provide an overview of the schema, a visual query builder to execute a SQL query, and a login system to control access to the data. The entire framework can run on a personal computer, or on a web server (for data sharing over the internet). ／ A PostgreSQL database is a pre-requisite to setting up this framework - specific tips on database schema design are provided in the Installation section. Configuration of PostgREST and PostGUI can be done in a matter of minutes. The PostGUI configuration file (at `/data/config.json`) in this repository demonstrates how to customize the front-end for a sample PostgreSQL database. PostgREST configuration is provided, along with some suggestions on PostgreSQL database schema design for optimal experience. ／ The client must organize the data to be shared in a PostgreSQL database running on a local computer (only data access, no data sharing over the internet) or a web server (data access, and data sharing over the internet). Certain features of PostGUI require specific database schema design. For example, to allow users to edit the database tables, the database tables must have a defined primary key (PK) attribute. However, if a PK is not defined for a table, PostGUI will gracefully disable the edit feature for the table.

identity.review: mq-bridge 是一个异步 Rust 库，通过统一的 receive_batch/send_batch 接口在 Kafka、NATS、MQTT、PostgreSQL、ClickHouse 等端点间路由消息与数据，支持 Postgres/MongoDB CDC、SQL 轮询写入、重试去重等中间件，并提供 Python/Node 绑定及零代码 CLI。适合需要在自有服务中嵌入数据管道、做 CDC 同步或事务性 outbox 的开发者使用。
highlights: 提供 PostgreSQL CDC（逻辑 replication/pgoutput）与 SQL 数据库读写端点
支持 ClickHouse 批量写入与可恢复读取
提供 Rust、Python、Node.js 三种语言的绑定及无代码 CLI（mq-bridge-app）
use_cases: 将 Postgres 变更流式同步到向量索引或数据仓库
实现数据库更新与事件发布的原子性 outbox 模式
在消息系统与 SQL 数据库之间搬运数据
